What this is, in plain English.
Small businesses lose customers in small ways: a call that goes to voicemail during a rush, a Google listing with old hours, a happy customer who never leaves a review. MKJ sets up software that handles those jobs for you.
"AI" here just means software that understands normal language and can reply in it, by voice or by text.
The main one is an  AI receptionist . When you can't get to the phone, it picks up instead of voicemail. It answers from what you told us, like your prices, hours and service area, books the job, and texts the customer a confirmation. Anything about money, complaints or emergencies goes to you. If a caller asks whether it's an AI, it says so.
You don't need to learn anything technical. You tell us how your business runs, you approve everything before a customer sees or hears it, and every account stays yours. No contracts. Monthly services cancel with 30 days' notice. Michael works with every client himself.
Talk to the demo receptionist Opens in your browser and uses your microphone. Tell it a business name, then ask what a customer would ask. It answers like it works there. ↗

Never miss another customer.
Built for mobile and local service businesses: cleaners, detailers, lawn care, handymen, salons and restaurants. Live in 7 days. You own every account.
Flagship
When you can't pick up, your AI does.
Your phone rings like it always does, and you answer when you can. If nobody picks up after a few rings, the call rolls to your AI receptionist instead of voicemail. It answers in your own voice, your booker's, or a professional receptionist voice you pick, quotes your prices, checks your service area, books the job and texts the customer a confirmation. Anything about money, complaints or emergencies goes straight to you.
from $249 / month
Includes 400 call minutes a month, then billed per minute. Choose a cloned voice (yours or your booker's, only with written consent) or one of our professional voices, ready the same day. The assistant tells callers it's an AI assistant if they ask.

Saturday.
You're booked for Saturday at 10. I just texted you a confirmation and a link to add notes for the crew.
Six services. Pick what fits.
Clear prices, no contracts. For each one: what it is in plain words, what happens on your end, what we need from you, your first week, and what it costs. We report real numbers every month and never promise results we can't control.
01 Never miss a call
Every call you can't pick up gets answered or texted back, so the customer books with you, not the next shop.  Talk to the demo receptionist ↗  (in your browser, uses your mic).
What it is.  When you can't get to the phone, a computer voice answers instead of voicemail. It knows your prices, hours and service area because you told us, and it can book the job. Text-back is the simpler version: it doesn't talk, it texts the caller your booking link right away.
Included
Text-back texts every missed caller your booking or quote link and answers common questions by text. Voice answers in a professional voice, quotes your prices and books into your calendar (400 call minutes a month). Signature uses your own voice or your booker's, with written consent, in English and Spanish (1,000 minutes). Money, complaints and emergencies always go to you.
How long
Most systems are live within 7 days of approving the plan.
What it costs
$99 to $399 a month, plus a one-time setup of $149 to $699. Extra minutes, phone numbers and texting fees at cost.
Text-back Every missed call gets a text with your booking link $99/mo + $149 setup Start
Voice Answers in a professional voice and books the job $249/mo + $499 setup Start
Signature Your own voice, English and Spanish $399/mo + $699 setup Start
On your end, step by step Your phone rings like normal. Answer when you can.
If nobody picks up after a few rings, the call goes to your assistant instead of voicemail.
It answers questions, offers times, books the job and texts the customer a confirmation.
Money, complaints and emergencies are sent straight to you.
What we need from you Your prices, hours, service area and the questions customers ask most. Access to your booking calendar if you want it to book. For Signature, a short voice recording and written consent from the person whose voice it is. We handle the phone setup with you.
Your first week Setup and testing. You hear it and approve the scripts before any customer does. Most systems go live within 7 days of approving the plan. After that, a results text every Friday shows calls answered, jobs booked and missed calls recovered.
02 Get found
Show up on Google, Google Maps and ChatGPT when people look for what you do.
What it is.  When someone nearby searches for what you do, your business should show up with the right name, phone number, hours and photos. We set that up on Google, Google Maps, Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp and Nextdoor so every listing matches. Complete adds a simple one-page website where people can book, and a check of what ChatGPT and Google's AI say about you.
Included
Essentials sets up and fills out your Google Business Profile, with the same name, phone and hours on Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp and Nextdoor. Complete adds a one-page booking website and a check and fix of what ChatGPT and Google AI say about you. Ongoing keeps it current with weekly Google posts and a monthly search check.
How long
One-time projects get their dates in your written plan before we start.
What it costs
$399 or $699 one time. $99 a month to keep it current.
Essentials Google profile plus Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp and Nextdoor $399 one time Start
Complete Essentials plus a booking website, and we check what ChatGPT says about you $699 one time Start
Ongoing Weekly Google posts and listings kept current $99/mo Start
On your end, step by step You give us your business details once.
We set up or clean up each listing so they all say the same thing.
With Ongoing, we post a weekly update to your Google profile and keep listings current.
What we need from you Your business name, address or service area, phone, hours, services and a few photos. Access to your Google Business Profile if you have one. Google sometimes asks the owner to verify the business; if it does, we walk you through it.
Your first week We look at what's listed about you today and start correcting it. Dates for the one-time work are in your written plan.
03 More reviews
Turn happy customers into Google reviews, and reply to every one.
What it is.  A simple way to get more Google reviews from customers you already have. The Kit is branded cards for your counter: a customer taps their phone on the card, or scans the QR code, and your Google review page opens. No app. The Engine sends customers a review request after each job and drafts a reply to every review for you to approve.
Included
The Kit is 3 branded tap-to-review cards, a counter sign with a QR code and 10 reply templates in your voice. The Engine sends a review request after each job, drafts a reply to every review and sends a monthly review report. Every customer is asked the same way, with no incentives.
How long
Engine + Kit includes a before-and-after review count at 30 days.
What it costs
$199 one time, $79 a month, or $249 for both and then $79 a month.
Kit Tap-to-review cards, counter sign, reply templates $199 one time Start
Engine Automatic review requests and drafted replies $79/mo Start
Engine + Kit Both, with a 30-day before-and-after count $249 then $79/mo Start
On your end, step by step Put the cards and the counter sign where customers pay.
Ask every customer the same way. Google doesn't allow asking only the happy ones, or offering rewards.
Customers tap or scan, and leave the review on Google.
We draft a reply to each review. Nothing posts until you approve it.
What we need from you The link to your Google Business Profile, or access to it. For the Engine, how you keep track of finished jobs or visits, so the requests go out at the right time.
Your first week The cards are designed for your business, and the dates are in your plan. With Engine + Kit we write down your review count at the start, so the 30-day before-and-after count is real.
04 Videos that bring customers in
Short videos for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. We make them and post them for you.  See the spec work .
What it is.  Short vertical videos, like the spec ads above, made for your business and posted to TikTok, Instagram or YouTube. You don't edit or post anything.
Included
Short videos with captions and hooks, made and posted for you. Starter is 4 videos a month on 1 platform. Standard is 12 videos and 4 ads on 2 platforms. Pro is 20 videos and 8 ads on 3 platforms, with a monthly content report.
How long
Monthly. Cancel with 30 days' notice.
What it costs
$149, $249 or $449 a month.
Starter 4 videos a month, 1 platform $149/mo Start
Standard 12 videos and 4 ads a month, 2 platforms $249/mo Start
Pro 20 videos and 8 ads a month, 3 platforms $449/mo Start
On your end, step by step You tell us what you sell, who buys it and what you want more of.
We plan and make the month's videos.
You approve them.
We post them and send the monthly report.
What we need from you Posting access to the accounts, your logo, and any photos or clips you already have. Photos or clips help. The spec ads above were made using only each brand's own website.
Your first week We agree on the month's plan together. Posting starts once you've approved the first videos.
05 Look established
Logos and brand design by a trained ad designer.
What it is.  A logo, and one matching look for everything customers see: business cards, social posts, signs and your van. Designed by Michael, who studies Advertising Design.
Included
A Logo comes in 3 directions with 2 rounds of edits, a color palette and files for print and social. The Brand kit adds business cards, social templates and a brand board any printer can use. Vehicle and sign work is designed as print-ready files for a local shop.
How long
Dates are set in your written plan before we start.
What it costs
$299 or $599 one time. Wraps and signs from $399, quoted per job.
Logo 3 directions, 2 rounds of edits, print and social files $299 one time Start
Brand kit Logo plus business cards, social templates, brand board $599 one time Start
Vehicle and signs Van wrap, door magnets, yard signs, banners from $399 Quote
On your end, step by step A short call about your business and the looks you like.
For a logo, you get 3 different directions and pick one.
Two rounds of changes.
You get the final files, ready for any printer and for social media.
What we need from you Your business name, what you do, any colors or logo you already have, and a few examples of looks you like.
Your first week The kickoff call. Exact dates for the directions and changes are in your written plan.
06 Company brain
An AI that knows your business: your documents, email, calendar, prices and policies. Your team asks a question and gets the answer with where it came from, plus a short briefing every morning. It runs on the same system MKJ uses to run itself.
What it is.  A private assistant for your team. Think of a coworker who has read your documents, email, calendar, prices and policies. Someone asks "what do we charge for this?" or "what's our policy on that?" and it answers, showing the document the answer came from. It also sends a short briefing each morning.
Included
Connected to the tools you already use, set up and tested with your team. Answers come with their source.
How long
Scoped on a call before anything is quoted.
What it costs
$2,500 setup. Book a call to scope it.
Company Brain Connected to the tools you already use, set up and tested with your team $2,500 setup Book a call
On your end, step by step A call to decide what it should read and who will use it.
We connect it to those tools and test it with your team.
Your team asks it questions in normal words.
What we need from you Access to the tools it should learn from, for example your shared files, email or calendar, and one person on your team to test it with us.
Your first week The scoping call. The setup plan and dates come after that.

Audit, build, launch, report.
The same four steps for every service. You approve each one before the next starts.
Audit
A free 30-minute call or visit. We look at how your calls, messages, reviews and content run today and pick the three tasks to automate first.
You get a written plan with scope and price.
Build
We set up and test the system on your accounts, in your brand voice. You approve the scripts before launch.
Nothing goes live without your approval.
Launch
Most systems are live within 7 days of approving the plan. Your profiles, numbers, content and customer data stay yours.
You own every account.
Report
A Friday results text and a monthly report with real numbers: calls answered, jobs booked, reviews. Then we improve what's next.
No promised results. Real numbers.

A branded card at your register opens your Google review page with a single tap. No app, no searching, no friction.

Michael Joyce
Michael Joyce is the founder of MKJ, a Pittsburgh agency that builds AI systems for local businesses. He studies Advertising Design at A.W. Beattie Career Center and works front-of-house at a Pittsburgh restaurant, which keeps his work grounded in how small businesses actually run.
MKJ runs on the same AI systems it builds for clients: lead research, content production, video editing and quality review. Michael shares what he learns about AI tools for business on TikTok and Instagram.
Based Pittsburgh, PA
Studying Advertising Design · A.W. Beattie
Find him @michaelkanejoyce
Straight answers.
If yours isn't here, ask the assistant in the corner or book a call.
Do you have clients yet?
MKJ is new, and we'd rather say so. Our tap-to-review cards are in use at a Pittsburgh restaurant. The ads on this page are spec work, not paid client work. Our first 10 clients keep their founding monthly rate for as long as they stay.
What does it cost?
Every price is on this page. Monthly services run $79 to $449 a month, and some have a one-time setup. One-time projects run $199 to $699, sign work is quoted from $399, and Company Brain is $2,500 setup. Pair any two monthly services and save 15%.
Is there a contract?
No contracts. Monthly services cancel with 30 days' notice. One-time projects are paid once.
How long does setup take?
Most systems are live within 7 days of approving the plan. Design and print work gets its dates in the written plan before we start.
Are there costs beyond the listed price?
Call minutes above the included amount, phone numbers and texting fees are billed at cost. Voice includes 400 call minutes a month and Signature includes 1,000.
Will callers know it's an AI?
The assistant tells callers it's an AI assistant if they ask. A cloned voice is only used with that person's written consent.
What happens when a question needs a person?
The customer is told a team member will follow up, and the conversation is sent to you immediately. Billing, complaints and special requests always go to your team.
What if the assistant misses a call?
If your assistant misses a call it should have answered, that month is free.
Do I need new software or a new phone number?
No. We connect to the tools you already use wherever possible and handle any setup ourselves.
Is it allowed to ask customers for Google reviews?
Yes. Google allows asking. It does not allow paying or rewarding people for reviews, or only asking happy customers. The kit asks everyone the same way.
Who owns the accounts and content?
You do. Your profiles, phone numbers, content and customer data remain yours at all times.
Can I pay online?
Yes. Each Start button opens Stripe's secure checkout. Quoted work and Company Brain start with a call.
